title: 5.7 Before dinner, after dinner
unit_outcome: Say how much and how many, offer and order food and drinks politely, agree about likes, say what you want and need to do, talk about meals, prices and what is in your food, compare prices, use numbers to ninety-nine and ask for things at the table.
goal: Say what you do before or after a meal (Ana washes her hands before dinner. / I drink coffee after breakfast.) and ask What do you do after dinner?
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 5.7 Meals: A1 says what I eat for breakfast, lunch and dinner and at what time; A1+ 5.7 places an action before or after a meal (Ana washes her hands before dinner. / Luis cleans the table after dinner.), with A1+ 1.2's he/she -s and the I-form. This is the before/after topic that left A1+ Unit 1 for A1 5.7 (2026-11-09); four of its 2026-10-31 dinner photos come back. A photo can show a meal waiting (a full plate) or finished (an empty plate), so only those photos set before against after; otherwise before and after are told apart by ear. A1+ 4.7's past comes back with cooked (Luis cooked dinner yesterday.). No clock times.
prerequisite: A1 5.7 breakfast, lunch, dinner, for lunch; A1+ 1.2 he/she -s; A1 4.7 clean; A1+ 4.5 washes; A1+ 4.7 -ed and yesterday; A1+ 1.7 What do you do …? frames.
speaking_outcome: Stress the meal after before and after (before DINner, after BREAKfast); do not require native-like speed.
